descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S19 Device with the wrong clock: prior note date, day-2 state and 37 h state follow the server

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U14 Every time rule in TC-13 (12/18/36 h windows, 'tomorrow', a prior note's default date) uses the server clock. A device with a wrong clock shows the same state as any other device. (UAT 3.8; TFA-94699 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Two devices on the same e2e-fresh-* account from freshAccount() on the local stack. Device A is normal; device B's clock is set 2 days ahead. Phones run a debug build bundled for the local stack: Android with adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 as in android-lane.ts, and iOS as an Xcode debug build whose Convex URL is the Mac's …

When On device B, paste a prior note with the date label empty and press Save & Extract, then save pre-round vitals. Then open the chart on device A and on device B, before and after the 20 h and 37 h points

Then The prior note's default date and stored time are the server's day, not device B's. Both devices show the same day-2 and 37 h state. Nothing written from device B clears early or survives late

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8 + TFA-94699 AC 7. Main writes previousNotes[].addedAt, labsUpdatedAt and vitalsUpdatedAt from the device clock and defaults the date label to the device date (risk list)

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
